asks: a meeting is with what is coming the OTHER way. What does that come to in a vacuum with no bias in it?

working: exits(p): DEG ways out, none of them special
steps.because: a point's exits are alike and a rule reads none of them by name, so what leaves a place goes every way alike

the facing factor is (1 - d^·j^)/2 and j^ is what the opposing population is doing on average. Alike in every direction, that is nothing - so a meeting in an undisturbed vacuum carries exactly a half, and the two limits it interpolates are one head-on and nought co-moving
